chapter.verse: Mipawl lamsang ah David’ suan ahi, sihna pan a thawhkikna hangin a siangtho Kha lamsang ah vangliatna a nei, Pasian’ Ta kici i Topa Zeisu Khazih ahi,
Pasian in a Tapa thu nidang lai-inah kamsangte tungah Lai Siangtho sungah thukiciamna Lungdamna Thu hilh nadingin a teelsa sawltak a, hong koih, Khazih Zeisu’ nasem keimah Paul in

Rom khua sungah a om misiangtho kikoih Pasian a it khempeuhte kiangah thu kong zasak hi. Tua Topa Zeisu Khazih leh i Pa Pasian’ hehpihna thupha leh nopna in nomau tungah om ta hen. Tua Topa Zeisu’ min hangin mipawl khempeuh in a up nadingin ama kiangah hehpihna thupha leh sawltak-za ka ngah hi. Zeisu Khazih’ mi suah nading hong sapsa note in zong tua mite lakah na om uh hi.
Nomau thu-upna in leitung gam khempeuh ah kizel ahih ciangin nomau hangin Zeisu Khazih tawh Pasian’ hehpihna ka phat masa bel hi.
Keimah in thu ka nget ciangin, note thu tawh zomin thu ka ngen niloh hi ci-in a Tapa’ Lungdamna Thu hilhin ka lungsim sungah a na ka sep Pasian in keima lamah teci ahi hi.
A nunung belin Pasian’ deihna in hong awi leh, nomau kiangah kong tun’ nadingin thu ka ngen hi.
Note na lungkip theih nadingun note kiangah Kha Siangtho’ thupha hehpihna khat peuhmah kong piak na’ngin nomau mu nuam ka hi hi.
Tua bang ka cihna in keimah leh nomau in thu-upna tawh khat leh khat nopna i ngah khawm ding ka cihnopna hi.

Ute naute aw, Gentail adangte lakah gah ka ngah mah bangin nomau lakah zong ka ngah nadingin nomau kiangah pai ning ci-in tamveipi ka hanciam ci-in note in na theih loh ding uh ka deih kei hi. Ahih hangin tu dongin, hong kham a om hi.
Grik mite ahi zongin, mi pil lote ahi zongin, siamna a nei mite ahi zongin, siamna a nei lo mite ahi zongin tuate khempeuh tungah leiba nei ka hi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka hih theih zahin Rom khua-ah a om note kiangah zong Lungdamna Thu kong hilh nuam hi.

Khazih’ Lungdamna Thu hangin ka maizum kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua thu in a masa-in Judah mite, a nung ciangin Grik mite akipan a um mi khempeuh in gupna a ngah nading Pasian’ vangliatna ahi hi.
“Midikte in thu-upna tawh a nungta ding hi,” ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin, thu-up nadingin thu-upna tawh Pasian’ dikna a kilang zo hi.
Gitlohna tawh thuman thutak a nial mite a gitlohna tungah Pasian’ hehna in vantung panin hong kilang hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ thu a kiteltakin amaute lakah a kilang hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ama tawntung vangliatna leh siangthona ahi, mit tawh kimu thei lo nate, lei apian’cil a kipan kilangin a kimu hi. Tua ahih ciangin amaute in a kisuahtak thei kei ding uh hi.

Amaute in Pasian a thei uh hi napi-in Pasian phat ding a kilawm zahin a phat kei uh a, ama hehpihna phat lo uh tham loin, amau in mawkna-in a ngaihsun uh a, ciamteh thei loin amau lungsim uh a mial hi.
“Lungpil mi ka hi uh hi,” a cih uh hangin mihai suak uh a,
kisia thei lo Pasian’ vangliatna in a sia thei mite ahi zongin, vasate ahi zongin, khe li nei ganhingte ahi zongin, bawkbak a, paite ahi zongin, tuate a milim tawh a kheek uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian in amau pumpi uh, amau mah in a siatsak theih nadingun amaute in lunggulhna a neih uh bangin kihhuaina sungah a pia hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian’ thuman thutak pen thuzuau tawh a kheek uh a, a Piangsakpa nusia-in a pian’sakte a bia uh hi. Tua Topa in thupha a ngah tawntung hi. Amen.
Tua bang ahih uh ciangin Pasian in amaute zumhuai lunggulhna khut sungah a pia hi. Amau numeite in a ngeina bang zui loin, a ngeina tawh kituak lo lam a zui uh hi.

Tua mah bangin pasalte in zong numeite tawh bawlna ngeina nusia-in, khat leh khat kilunggulh uh a, pasal khat leh khat zumhuai kibawl uh a, amaute mawhna tawh kituak daan a pum sung uh ah a thuak uh hi.
Amaute in Pasian thei nuam lo uh ahih ciangin a kituak lo nate ahih nading Pasian in amaute gitlohna lungsim sungah a piak mah bangin,
diklohna tawh, gitlohna tawh, duhgawh huaihamna tawh, hazatna tawh, en’na tawh, mi thahna tawh, kitotna tawh, kheemna tawh, etsat muhdahna tawh a dim uh hi.
Amaute in mi gendai thei mi, hangsan mi, Pasian mudah mi, kheltat mi, kisathei mi, kiphasak mi, mi’ gitlohna a piangsak mi, a nute a pate’ thu a ngai lo mi,
kikepna nei lo mi, kiciam pelh mi, unau it lo mi, hehpih lungsim nei lo mi a suak uh hi.
Tua bang gamtate in sihna daan a thuak ding uh ci-in Pasian’ thukham thei napi-in, amaute in ahih uh tham loin, tua bang ahih mite a awi uh hi.
